newsitem.title: FRANCE: Goldsmith in French hospital with cancer.
newsitem.headline: Goldsmith in French hospital with cancer.

text.p: Anglo-French entrepreneur Sir James Goldsmith is critically ill with cancer in a hospital near Paris, a source close to him said on Monday.
The source, who asked not to be named, said Goldsmith's daughter Jemima, wife of former Pakistan cricket captain Imran Khan, was with him at the hospital along with other family members and friends.

Goldsmith, 64, first suffered pancreatic cancer in 1985 but its recurrence was kept secret when he led his Referendum Party in the six-week campaign for Britain's general election on May 1, the British newspaper The Times said earlier on Monday.

The party, campaigning against further European Union integration, won more than 800,000 votes but failed to win a seat in the election, which resulted in a landslide victory for Tony Blair's Labour Party.
The source refused to say at which hospital Goldsmith was being treated.
The Times quoted friends of Goldsmith as saying they were concerned about his condition.
"I think it is very bad. He is a hero. He fought that (election) campaign, having confided in only a handful of people, despite the most chronic pains," said one unidentified friend.
Goldsmith masterminded million-dollar Wall Street deals and made a vast fortune as one of the most cool and astute corporate raiders of his time.
He amassed millions by buying into companies and then selling the stock for big profits after takeover speculation had boosted share prices.
